title: EXAMPLE: Missing tenant for SKU in Sirius (Poland)
root_cause: EXAMPLE / UNVERIFIED seed card. The SKU exists in Catalog.Product but has no Catalog.ProductTenant row for the country's tenant (or the product master sync did not deliver it), so the product is invisible in that market. This is a master-data request, not a code defect.
fix_steps: Resolve the TenantId of the country with tenant_lookup.
Run product_sku_lookup: NO ROWS = product missing from the product master (check the product sync job with job_health); AssignedToTenant = 0 = needs a Catalog.ProductTenant assignment.
Route to the master-data team to assign the SKU to the tenant; no code change needed.
